title: The gate classifier gives a gate that only names the Python tokenize module the secrets class
goal: A gate whose text only names the Python tokenize module is classed design, not secrets, while a token, secret or credential in it still classes secrets

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;sys.exit(0 if a.derived_class({'touches':[]},{'id':'g1','question':'Use the tokenize module or a regex scan?','options':['tokenize','regex']})=='design' else 1)

notes: SP-j65ihctq retrospective: the misclass made ST-2jsyxkpf's design gate g1 blocking class secrets, so its landing waited on an operator answer for a choice with no secret in it.
